package probe

import "os/exec"

// The element literals elide their type: the slice and the map name exec.Cmd,
// so each element builds a command of its own, with no Env key, however little
// the literal itself writes. An element whose Env key holds a composite
// literal is accepted, as the literal that names the type is.
func compositeElided() {
	_ = []*exec.Cmd{{Path: "/bin/sh"}}
	_ = map[string]*exec.Cmd{"sh": {Path: "/bin/sh"}}
	_ = []*exec.Cmd{{Path: "/bin/sh", Env: []string{"PATH=/usr/bin"}}}
}
